resolution.note: the host-path guard is one of the three .mjs rule tests preflight now runs

title: Run the host-path guard in preflight
body:
Outcome: `npm run preflight` runs test/rules/host-path-guard.test.mjs, so a host-specific path literal fails before push.
Evidence: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/predecessor-retire/ (PR #159). krn/gate on 7208c89 failed only on host-path-guard (two herdr capture literals); it cost one CI cycle (16 min), a D10 exception and a third review panel.
